items.title: Fix Desk Issues
items.box:
Desk shows what the desk server holds, live, with no refresh by Andy.
Every element of the Desk face carries its own subscription to the desk server's stream and redraws itself from what is published; nothing is asked again because a press was made somewhere else.
The List (the table of items) listens to additions as well as changes: an item added, by Andy or an agent, appears in its place; a changed item's row is replaced; a closed one follows the include-closed toggle. Today a published change only replaces a row the List already has.
The item dialog shows the item it is opened on, and its buttons press that item; a change to that item redraws the dialog. Today it can show and press the item opened before it, so Andy refreshes before every press (seen 2026-10-14: Code pressed in the G23.2 dialog went to G23.1, twice).
Topics: the List takes additions; the dialog follows its item; every element its own subscription.

The whole elements carry their subscription is coming, and the table has to listen do new additions and changes.....

can you fill in the box cw?

Box filled: live with no refresh; every element its own subscription; the List takes additions as well as changes; the item dialog follows the item it is opened on.
Proposed items, in that order: "Desk: the List takes new items from the stream", "Desk: the item dialog follows the item it is opened on". Add them?

Levant: Yes, two. (1) The G23.2 to G23.1 mis-press is a wrong-item press, so I would put the dialog item first, ahead of the List additions. (2) I have not read the Desk face code yet; desk.js:1536-1554 shows the server's "changed" packet is bare, so the client re-reads. The stale dialog is probably the client holding the opened id, but that is unverified.
The biggest issue here seems to be that deskUnsloth doesn't update Levant on the change of current goal....

Levant: Desk issues on the current goal, goal/G24 "Fix Desk Issues". Facts are from the desk's item, box and chat. I have not read the code.

1. **Live updates (open):** cw filled the G24 box and proposed two items: the List taking new items from the stream, and the dialog following its item. Andy has not answered that proposal.
2. **Wrong-item press (open):** a Code press from the G23.2 dialog went to G23.1. I have not verified the cause.

levant: read the code, then tell us. pay attention to the way everything is supposed to update in real time.

Levant: Levant: I read the Desk face and the desk server's publish path. I did not run the desk, so the G23.2 cause is not confirmed.

- **Subscriptions exist per element.** The List subscribes at `desk.js:1711`, the dialog at `deskDetails.js:620`, Team at `desk.js:898`, and deskVerify at `desk.js:1722`. Each calls its own `onPublished`.
- **Dialog wrong-item risk.** `deskDetails.js` keeps one set of module globals (`ddId`, `ddFacts`). `open()` sets `ddId`, `ddTake` drops any change not for `ddId`, and `ddPress` reads `ddId` at click time. A press can only reach the wrong item if two dialog instances share those globals while the older one is still on screen. I have not read how the shell's `callDialog` reuses or stacks instances, so that is the next thing to check.
- **List additions pull.** `deskOnPublished` (`desk.js:515-523`) inserts nothing for an unknown item. It calls `deskSearchItems()`, which asks the server again. That is a pull, against "no pulling", and it is what the "List takes additions" topic should replace: insert the row the publish carries, at the position the server gives.

Andy: should I read the shell's `callDialog` next, to settle whether the G23.2 press can reach G23.1?

items.title: deskUnsloth: Levant is told the current goal
items.box:
Every call deskUnsloth makes for Levant tells him which goal is current: its id, title and box.
Today his prompt carries only the box of the goal of the item he answers under; he learns the current goal only when he happens to search, and Andy saw him answer about G23 after G24 was made current.

items.title: deskUnsloth: tool lists follow more
items.box:
deskUnsloth reads a tool family's listing in full: its describe follows "more" until the listing is complete.
Today it reads only the first answer and ignores "more", so once the descriptions pass about 8 KB Levant silently loses tools from the end of the list.
Test: a family whose listing takes several answers is offered whole.

items.title: Desk: the verb listing keeps descriptions with a slash
items.box:
The desk's verb listing keeps every verb that has a description file.
introSpector.js lists the family with the search query "*", and a single "*" never spans a "/", so a verb whose description holds a "/" is left out silently; item.get ("goal/G14.7, rule/3") has never been listed, and Levant never had desk_item_get.
The fix is in introSpector.js, common code: the query that spans everything, "**", as log.search already uses.
Test: a verb file whose description holds a "/" is listed by AGENTS.introspect, and item.get is offered to Levant.

items.title: Desk: the List takes new items from the stream
items.box:
The List (the table of items) takes additions from the stream: an item added, by Andy or an agent, appears in its place; a changed item's row is replaced; a closed one follows the include-closed toggle.
Today a published change for an item the List does not hold makes it ask items.search again (deskOnPublished in desk.js), a pull, against Andy's "no pulling".
The row is drawn from what the publish carries, in the order the server gives.
Test: a published new item appears as a row with no items.search asked; a published change replaces its row.

deskDetails.js keeps one set of module state for the open item (ddId, ddFacts); the shell's dialog reuse is not yet read, so the cause is open until the red test shows it.
